# Rural Property Tax Search, Courts Services Online, Wills Registry, Sites Registry and BC Assessment Reports moving from BC Online to new BC Registry

_Category: Announcements · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**Fareen** (5/19/2022):

**Notice to any organizations using automated processes for Rural Property Tax Search, Courts Services Online, Wills Registry, Sites Registry and BC Assessment Reports on BC OnLine (BCOL):**
 These BCOL applications will be modernized and moving over to the new BC Registry application from June 22, 2022 â€“ September 2022 and will be decommissioned in BCOL. Once they are modernized, you will need to login through the user interface (UI) to access these applications in the new [BC Registry](https://www.bcregistry.gov.bc.ca/) application. API services are not available and you may need to update any automated processes.
